    • TESTS_BASE_URL

      public static final String TESTS_BASE_URL
      Base url on which the functional tests are run. Default value is https://jspwiki-wiki.apache.org.

    • TESTS_CONFIG_DOWNLOADS_FOLDER

      public static final String TESTS_CONFIG_DOWNLOADS_FOLDER
      Selenide tests download's folder. Default value is ./target/downloads.

    • TESTS_CONFIG_HEADLESS

      public static final boolean TESTS_CONFIG_HEADLESS
      Should the browser start on headless mode? Only for Firefox / Chrome. Default value is false.

    • TESTS_CONFIG_REPORTS_FOLDER

      public static final String TESTS_CONFIG_REPORTS_FOLDER
      Selenide tests reports' folder. Default value is ./target/selenide.

    • TESTS_CONFIG_SEARCH_INDEX_WAIT

      public static final long TESTS_CONFIG_SEARCH_INDEX_WAIT
      Amount of time, in milliseconds, to wait for the search index tasks to complete. Default value is 1200.

      public static final String TESTS_CONFIG_BROWSER_SIZE
      Which size should start the browser with?. Default value is 1366x768.

      public static final String TESTS_CONFIG_WDM_TARGET_PATH
      Folder where the WebDriver will be downloaded. Default value is ./target/wdm.
